@@ -1,2 +1,24 @@
 class Cache:
+    def __init__(self, ttl, clock=None):
+        self.ttl = ttl
+        self._clock = clock or (lambda: 0)
+        self._data = {}
+    
+    def set(self, key, value, clock=None):
+        if clock is None:
+            clock = self._clock
+        if value is None:
+            self._data[key] = (value, self._clock())
+        else:
+            self._data[key] = (value, self._clock())
+    
+    def get(self, key, default=None):
+        if key in self._data:
+            value, timestamp = self._data[key]
+            elapsed = self._clock() - timestamp
+            if elapsed >= self.ttl:
+                del self._data[key]
+                return default
+            return value
+        return default
  pass
